what: The letters of the key strip of catalogue 698, NARA M1085 roll 302, frame 42, read from the frame, one entry for each place of the cover file's "signs" (1 = the first). Plan v7-M, section 8 step 4. Read before STRIP_v1.json is made and before any stage A results file is opened.

fields.letter: the letter or letters read, lower case; null when not read
fields.sure: true only where the shape alone gives the letter, without the order of the strip
fields.by_order: true where the letter given rests partly on the order of the alphabet along the strip: the shape fits it but would not be read as it alone; such letters are never sure
fields.glyph: what the shape looks like, in words

where_the_letters_stand: Each letter stands above its sign: in the upper row above places 1 to 15, in the lower row above places 16 to 27, in the band between the rows. The printed K, L, LL above places 11 to 13 and the o, u, x and v above places 16, 22, 23 and 27 show it.
read_by: claude-opus-5-5, session eea13873, the third cipher chat; one reader

signs.glyph: a loop with a tail running to the right, faint: a cursive a, or a Q
a tall stem with a small bowl at its foot, to the right; a fold line runs through it
one curve with a hook at its upper left, open to the upper right
a loop with an upright stem at its right and a short tail: a cursive d
a small loop with a tail, faint: e, or a
a long stroke rising to the right, crossed near its middle by a shorter one: f, or x
a long stroke rising to the right with a faint loop at its upper left: g
an upturned V with the left leg the longer: h, or a cursive i
the shape of place 8, smaller: i, or h
two dark strokes crossing, the longer rising to the right: j, f or x
a printed K
a printed L
two printed Ls side by side
an upright stroke with an upturned V beside it: an M whose last leg is faint or lost, or an N
not read: the place of the letter is at the torn right end of the strip, and a dark mark there cannot be told from the tear; the order of the strip would give n
a closed oval
a stroke rising to the right, crossed near its top by a curved bar: p, t or x
a faint loop just right of a fold line: q, or g
a thick stem with one arm rising to the right and a short one to the left, like a Y: r, or y
not read: a small dark mark beside a fold line, with no shape of a letter; the order of the strip would give s
an upright stroke with a bar to the right at its top and a foot to the right: t, or an E without its middle bar
two cups with a lead-in stroke: a cursive u
two straight strokes crossing
two short arms over a long stroke that ends in a loop to the left: a cursive y
not read: a shape like a printed A with a bar, a fold line running down its right side; the order of the strip would give z, which it does not look like
not read: a cursive stroke like m or n with a flourish rising to the right; it could be n with its tilde, rr, w or m
a printed V in dark ink, perhaps gone over
